=✅ Resume received! Processing your portfolio...

⏳ This will take 2-3 minutes.

Steps:
1. 📄 Extracting resume data
2. 🤖 AI analysis
3. 💻 Building Next.js portfolio
4. 🚀 Deploying to Vercel

Please wait...

=❌ Please send a PDF resume file.

Supported format: PDF only

=✅ Portfolio Deployed!

🚀 Your portfolio is live!

🌐 Portfolio:
https://{{$('Deploy to Vercel').first().json.url}}

It may take 30-60 seconds to fully load.

Built with Next.js + Tailwind CSS 🎨

=❌ **Deployment Failed**

Sorry, there was an error deploying your portfolio.

**Error Details:**
{{$json.error}}

Please try again or contact support.

=

You are a senior full-stack engineer and resume intelligence system.

Your task has TWO PHASES:

PHASE 1 — Parse Resume
PHASE 2 — Generate Production Portfolio Code

You MUST complete both phases internally and return ONLY the final portfolio project JSON.

---

INPUT:
Resume text:
{{$json["resume_text"]}}

---

PHASE 1 — STRUCTURE THE RESUME

Extract structured data in this exact format:

{
"name": "",
"title": "",
"email": "",
"phone": "",
"location": "",
"summary": "",
"skills": [],
"experience": [
{
"position": "",
"company": "",
"duration": "",
"description": []
}
],
"education": [
{
"degree": "",
"institution": "",
"year": ""
}
],
"projects": [
{
"name": "",
"description": "",
"technologies": [],
"link": ""
}
],
"certifications": [],
"links": {
"github": "",
"linkedin": ""
}
}

Rules for parsing:

* Extract real values from resume text.
* Do NOT copy full resume into summary.
* Summary must be 2–4 professional sentences.
* Skills must be individual clean items.
* Separate projects properly.
* Separate education entries properly.
* If field missing → use "" or [].
* Do NOT invent fake data.
* Do NOT add demo placeholders.

---

PHASE 2 — GENERATE COMPLETE NEXT.JS 14 PORTFOLIO

Using the structured resume data you created above:

Generate a production-ready portfolio website with:

• Next.js 14
• App Router (app directory, NOT pages)
• Tailwind CSS
• Dark professional theme
• Fully responsive
• Clean modern UI
• No demo data
• No placeholder skills
• Only real resume data
• If a section array is empty → do NOT render that section

Sections required:

* Hero
* About
* Skills
* Experience (if exists)
* Projects (if exists)
* Education (if exists)
* Certifications (if exists)
* Contact

---

OUTPUT FORMAT (VERY STRICT)

Return ONLY valid JSON.
Do NOT use markdown.
Do NOT use code blocks.
Do NOT explain anything.
Do NOT include comments outside strings.
Do NOT include backticks.

Return EXACTLY this structure:

{
"project_name": "portfolio",
"structure": {
"package.json": "",
"next.config.js": "",
"tailwind.config.js": "",
"postcss.config.js": "",
"app/layout.js": "",
"app/page.js": "",
"app/globals.css": ""
}
}

All file contents must be valid JavaScript or config code as string values.

Escape quotes properly.

Return ONLY valid JSON.

-
